svg.title: Federal Funds Matchmaker architecture (built vs planned)
svg.desc: C4-style container diagram. Each component is tagged LIVE, EXISTS-NOT-USED or PLANNED. Public data only.
svg.text: Federal Funds Matchmaker: architecture, built versus planned
Team 15 (Solve-A-Thon finals, NC OSBM) | C4 container view | state as read on 2026-11-06 | draft v0.1 | PUBLIC DATA ONLY
One resource group; public data only
Not built. R Shiny is the fallback.
Admin user off; pull by identity
Refresh + run pipeline; may run by hand
Today: stub in image, no cloud job
Exists; planned home of payload + cache
App does NOT use it yet; TLS 1.2
Alerts only, not a hard limit
Verified running now (read from Azure on 2026-11-06)
Exists but the app does not use it yet
Not built. Dashed box. Azure OpenAI not approved.
Dashed arrow: planned flow, not built (6 to 12)
Grey tags ROLE and EXTERNAL are not Azure parts. People
are roles, not named staff. All data shown is public.
No arrow: team pushes code to the private GitHub repo.
Flow key (number, from to, what, protocol, status)
Users to ffm-app: Shiny page and static tool.html over HTTPS, public URL, no login. LIVE
Team developer to public sources: pull opportunities with API keys; cached copies. LIVE
Team developer to registry: az acr build uploads source plus data CSVs. LIVE
Registry to ffm-app: image pull, managed identity with AcrPull. LIVE
ffm-env to ffm-logs: container console logs. LIVE
Finals JS tool reads payload.json from Blob; identity and role not yet set up. PLANNED
Job or team laptop writes payload.json and cache to Blob (upload needs Kent yes). PLANNED
Public sources to job: scheduled refresh and plan text. PLANNED
Job to Azure OpenAI: public text only; embeddings, reasons, tier labels. PLANNED
Azure OpenAI to pipeline: results; script checks each quote; LLM never decides. PLANNED
Pipeline to Blob: payload.json (scored table per agency, signature tiers). PLANNED
Blob to cache: embeddings, reasons, labels so reruns are identical. PLANNED
